name: Yoghurt, berry and oat parfait
summary: Glasses layered with plain yoghurt, berries, banana and crunchy oven-toasted oats and seeds, sweetened only by the fruit.
about: Parfait is French for 'perfect' and first meant a frozen dessert; the layered glass of yoghurt, fruit and crunchy oats is the American breakfast version. Toasting plain oats at home leaves out the sugar that most bought granola carries.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C if your oven is a fan oven). Mix the oats, sunflower seeds, pumpkin seeds and cinnamon on a baking tray and spread them out thinly.
Toast for 8–10 minutes, stirring halfway, until the oats are golden and smell nutty. Leave to cool on the tray for 5 minutes; they crisp up as they cool.
Crush half the berries with a fork to a rough purée and swirl it through the yoghurt, leaving pink streaks. Slice the bananas.

Layer into 4 glasses: a spoonful of yoghurt, a sprinkle of toasted oats, then berries and banana. Repeat, finishing with the whole berries and a last scatter of oats, and serve straight away while the oats are crunchy.
prepNote: Toast a double batch of oats; it keeps 2 weeks in an airtight jar. Thaw frozen berries in the fridge overnight.
